# EverNest

Product key: evernest
Canonical product: https://evernest-home.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evernest/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evernest/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Guardian: Use Guardian for verified public resource navigation such as food, housing, childcare, transportation, benefits or legal-aid resources. EverNest remains family coordination/support, not emergency response.
- Evercraft Home: Family memories and community history can live in Evercraft Home while EverNest focuses on practical support and trusted circles.

## Use this capability when the user means

- I just had a baby and need practical help
- organize meals and practical help for a new parent
- build a trusted family support circle
- help my family prepare for a new baby
- family support checklist after having a baby
- maternal and family support resources
- family support resources
- trusted support circle concepts
- family preparedness resources
- Spanish-language family support resources

## Authority

public resource discovery only

## Boundaries

- does not diagnose, score urgency, or determine whether abuse or danger occurred
- not an emergency-response service
- private family, child, Care Circle, task, note, upload, location, and account data are not public
